notes: v1.30: (1) Edit a past sale — Dashboard E / Edit Last Sale for the latest sale, Daily Entries E / Edit Sale for any past date; weight, mode, amount, bill no., remarks and split all editable, old values stay in the audit trail (SALE_EDIT). (2) Split payment while selling — tick Split, pick Mode 2, enter Part 2; Part 1 = Total - Part 2; a bad split turns the split line RED and BLINKS and blocks Save; Excel shows the split in Remarks, total counted once. (3) Great Category search — type any part (RING finds LADIES RING + GENTS RING, CHAIN finds LADIES CHAIN + GENTS CHAIN), popup with ranked matches + count, Down/Up/Enter/Esc/click, B opens the list; Space types a real space while searching, jumps to the table only when the field is empty. (4) Mettler Opening Weight — Enter saves at once, no popup to dismiss, focus stays on Opening Weight for the next box, no mouse needed; Shift+Tab to change Category. (5) Bug fix: typed numbers in weight fields (v1.25 numbers-only check had a wrong method signature and could reject digits). Includes v1.29 (any Python 3.8+ launcher, locked Python), v1.28, v1.27, v1.26, v1.25 and all earlier versions.
